text: Certainty of evidence of required resources What is the certainty of the evidence of resource requirements (costs)? JUDGEMENT RESEARCH EVIDENCE ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS ○ Very low ● Low ○ Moderate ○ High ○ No included studies The drug prices for the regimens were elicited from the Stop TB Partnership Global Drug Facility and health system and patient costs in the three settings were estimated based on data from an economic modelling analysis (Ryckman et al. 2024) and extrapolated to the 3-month time period for the difference in the treatment durations. The estimated costs from the economic modelling analysis do not account for possible imprecision in the cost estimates and provide indirect data for other settings where the BEAT TB treatment regimen would be used.
